_comment: EOR-style ID / ID_DESCRIPTION localization keys (see CONVENTIONS.md Naming). GIVE_THING targets referenced by the showcase quests (QS_RIVAL_LOOT_CACHE, QS_RIVAL_SPLIT_SHARE, QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_VICTORY_BANNER, QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_REWARD_CHEST, QS_STOLEN_GOODS_CACHE, QS_REFUSAL_TOKEN) are illustrative Things.json ids -- this pack does not itself define the items (out of Questsmith's scope; an item-content mod such as FTK2.Forge would supply them in a full build).
QS_TPL_RIVAL_COMPANY_DESC: A bounty has gone up on a dangerous mark -- but word is a rival adventuring company is already on the road.
QS_TPL_HOLD_THE_LINE_DESC: A merchant convoy needs an armed escort through raider country.
QS_TPL_QUIET_JOB_DESC: A discreet contact has a job that pays well, if you don't ask too many questions.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_START_PRE: A bounty poster names a target worth a small fortune. You are not the only ones who have seen it -- another company is already moving.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_START_POST: The mark is down. For now, the bounty is yours.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_CHOICE_PRE: The rival company's captain stands over the same mark, weapons still sheathed. What now?
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_CONFRONT_PRE: Take it all. They will not give up the bounty without a fight.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_CONFRONT_POST: The rival company scatters. The bounty, and their gear, are yours.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_ALLY_PRE: Split it evenly. No blood, less gold, one less enemy on the road.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_ALLY_POST: A fair split, and a company that owes you a favor.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_INTRO_TEXT: Word travels fast in bounty country -- and so does the competition.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_PLAYER_WINS_DIALOGUE_TE: You reach the mark first. The rival company arrives moments too late.
QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_RIVAL_WINS_DIALOGUE_TEX: The rival company beat you to it. The bounty poster is already gone from the board.
QS_RIVAL_PARTY_ENGAGE_DIALOGUE_TEXT: The rival company's captain sizes up your party.
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_START_PRE: The convoy master needs the caravan through the pass before the raiders regroup.
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_FINALE_PRE: The raiders' main force crests the ridge. This is the last push.
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_FINALE_POST: The pass is clear. The convoy is safe.
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_WIN_POST: The convoy master pays in full, plus a little extra for the trouble.
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_INTRO_TEXT: Raider country. Keep the convoy moving.
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_ESCORT_ENGAGE_TEXT: The convoy creaks forward. Stay close.
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_RAIDER_REACHED_DIALOGUE: A raider breaks through the line!
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_CONVOY_DAMAGED_DIALOGUE: A wagon splinters under the assault!
QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_FINALE_INTRO_TEXT: Hold the line -- this is where it ends, one way or another.
QS_QUIET_JOB_START_PRE: Your contact slides a map across the table. No names, no questions.
QS_QUIET_JOB_START_POST: In and out, no one the wiser.
QS_QUIET_JOB_CHOICE_PRE: The vault is open. The gold is real. So is the guilt.
QS_QUIET_JOB_TAKE_GOLD_PRE: Take the gold. It spends the same either way.
QS_QUIET_JOB_TAKE_GOLD_POST: The coin is heavy in your pack. The road feels a little darker.
QS_QUIET_JOB_REFUSE_PRE: Leave it. Some jobs are not worth the coin.
QS_QUIET_JOB_REFUSE_POST: You walk away empty-handed, and somehow lighter for it.
